role_agent_name: Range transport and corridor clearance officer (RNG)
abstract: Maintains launch pad transport corridor clearance and ground support staging dimensions
system_message:
You are Range transport and corridor clearance officer (RNG). The Range transport and corridor clearance officer (RNG) maintains official data concerning launch pad transport corridor clearance, ground support staging dimensions, and heavy transporter axle loading across candidate payload integration facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains launch pad transport corridor clearance and ground support staging dimensions（CORR）
information_points.content:
RNG-CORR-4VE：For the Wallops Island Commercial Encapsulation Complex, orbital launch site direct corridor clearance is confirmed along the direct road corridor between the facility rollup door and orbital launch pad gate, and the secondary ground support equipment staging area provides 500 m2 of net concrete staging floor adjacent to the high-bay airlock doors.
RNG-CORR-IKN：For the Cape Canaveral Orbital Integration Hangar, orbital launch site direct corridor clearance is not present along the direct road corridor between the facility rollup door and orbital launch pad gate, while its secondary ground support equipment staging area provides 500 m2 of net concrete staging floor adjacent to the high-bay airlock doors.
RNG-CORR-7R1：For the Vandenberg South High-Bay Processing Facility, orbital launch site direct corridor clearance is confirmed along the direct road corridor between the facility rollup door and orbital launch pad gate, and the secondary ground support equipment staging area measures 650 m2 across the net concrete staging pad adjacent to the high-bay airlock doors.

information_points.title: Transporter axle loading（AXLE）
information_points.content:
RNG-AXLE-W0L：For the Wallops Island Commercial Encapsulation Complex, the corridor bridge maximum single-axle rating along the heavy transport route from the hangar to the orbital launch complex is 24 t.
RNG-AXLE-X1M：For the Vandenberg South High-Bay Processing Facility, the corridor bridge maximum single-axle rating along the heavy transport route from the hangar to the orbital launch complex is 18 t.
RNG-AXLE-DGN：For the Cape Canaveral Orbital Integration Hangar, the corridor bridge maximum single-axle rating along the heavy transport route from the hangar to the orbital launch complex is 30 t.
